metadata.remarks:
Endpoint Configuration and Hardening defines the preventive controls that establish a secure endpoint execution environment. This includes operating system hardening, explicit control of which applications and scripts may execute, and restriction of user-installed software. These controls are enforced by design and are not dependent on runtime detection or health evaluation.

Governance and Responsibility Anchor:
This pattern is the authoritative anchor for SSPPs, standards, procedures, guidelines, and assurance related to endpoint secure configuration and application allow/deny enforcement.
